surfaces.label: Login
surfaces.purpose: Sign in to the Zyvor Janus web console (session cookie).
operate: Open `http://<host>:3000/login` (or you are redirected here).
Enter dashboard credentials (default **Admin** / **Admin@321** unless `ZYVOR_JANUS_DASHBOARD_USER` / `PASSWORD` override).
Submit — session is an httpOnly cookie (≈7 days).
**Empty / fail:** Login failed → check API on `:8080` and env credentials; middleware blocks `/api` without auth.
**Success:** Land on Dashboard; sidebar shows Dashboard · Runs · Benchmark · What-if · Twins.

surfaces.label: Dashboard
surfaces.purpose: Mission Control — launch simulations, compare configs, and jump into recent runs.
operate: Open `/` after sign-in.
**Launch simulation**: pick a cluster config → optional shadow scheduler → **Run** (or **Run + shadow**).
**Compare configs**: choose A and B → Compare → review metric deltas in ComparePanel.
Open a recent run → `/runs/:id`, or jump to Benchmark / What-if shortcuts.
Anchor **/#runs** focuses the runs list (sidebar Runs).
**Empty / fail:** No configs → ensure `configs/clusters/` is visible to the API; Run fails → check FastAPI logs on `:8080`.
**Success:** New run appears; Open navigates to run detail.

surfaces.label: Simulate
surfaces.purpose: Live scheduling replay — watch requests → queue → GPU assign → complete for a run.
operate: Open `/simulate` or `/simulate?run=<id>` from a completed/in-progress run.
Select a run if needed → **Watch** / load to stream the SimulateStage.
Follow legend for scheduler decisions; respect reduced-motion preferences.
Jump **Run detail** or **Dashboard** from actions.
**Empty / fail:** No runs to watch → start one from Dashboard; busy spinner → wait for snapshot.
**Success:** Stage animation advances with decisions for the selected run.

surfaces.label: Benchmark
surfaces.purpose: Scheduler benchmarks with inference TTFT/TPS metrics, score vectors, and AIPerf twin comparison.
operate: Open `/benchmark`.
Configure the benchmark case → **Run benchmark**.
Read Score vector radar and Sim vs measured (AIPerf twin) panels.
Open recent benchmark reports → link into `/runs/:id`.
**Empty / fail:** Running stuck → API/engine error; no TTFT → non-LLM workload.
**Success:** Report row appears with colored cells vs best-in-column.

surfaces.label: What-if
surfaces.purpose: Sweep schedulers on the same inference workload and compare a results matrix.
operate: Open `/what-if`.
Pick base config (e.g. `small_h100.yaml`) and subset of schedulers.
**Run sweep** → inspect Results matrix bars; **Download CSV** when offered.
**Empty / fail:** No schedulers selected → enable at least one; sweep fails → config path.
**Success:** Matrix populated for each scheduler under test.

surfaces.label: Twins
surfaces.purpose: AIPerf-calibrated GPU/model performance twins that ground the simulator against measured hardware.
operate: Open `/twins`.
Browse calibrated twins; sort/filter by measured_at.
Open linked AIPerf run when `aiperf_run_id` is present.
**Empty / fail:** No twins calibrated yet → run AIPerf calibration pipeline per product docs.
**Success:** Twin cards list hardware/model pairs used by Benchmark sim-vs-measured.

surfaces.label: Run detail
surfaces.purpose: Inspect one simulation run — cluster/queue view, metrics, and jump to Simulate.
operate: Open `/runs/<id>` from a run link.
Read status, metrics, and cluster/queue panels.
**Open in Simulate** to replay scheduling decisions.
**Back to dashboard** when done.
**Empty / fail:** Run not found → stale id or API offline.
**Success:** Run payload loads; Simulate deep-link works.
